verdict: Lead costs are rising; creative refresh and overdue milestones being addressed now.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 112 leads at a blended cost of $10.28 per lead — but the trend within that window is moving in the wrong direction. In the most recent 7 days, leads dropped 33% and cost per lead spiked 52% on nearly flat spend, a pattern consistent with creative fatigue on the single campaign carrying almost all of your budget. Google Business Profile activity also fell 21% week-over-week, reinforcing a broader softening in demand signals this period. Ad creative is being refreshed this week to relieve the fatigue on that campaign, and outstanding launch milestones — overdue since July — are being escalated to close the gap. Next period, the goal is a lower cost per lead as fresh creative rotates in and additional campaign lanes come online.
